policy: No requirement is Done unless its status and evidence are explicitly recorded. New work must not delete preserved V8-V19.7 behavior.

requirements.title: Master requirements registry with stable IDs
Patch-pack manifest and overlay upgrade mechanism
Rollback script and backup before patch
Definition of Done checklist per requirement
Real-time API sync contract between field and office
Offline-first field cache and conflict model
Arrival mortality separated from farm mortality
Daily farm mortality and cumulative mortality rates
Water per bird and water:feed ratio
Farm on-hand stock separated from supplier availability
Veterinary review before final daily close
Fixed flock summary strip on flock screens
Worker boundary: records data but cannot approve treatment
AI proposal -> vet review -> approval -> worker task
Differential diagnosis terminology instead of definitive AI diagnosis
Evidence quality gate for necropsy/droppings images
Clinical diagnosis vs laboratory-confirmed state machine
Disease risk radar as warning signal, not diagnosis
AI daily analysis report with confidence and missing data
Marketplace Customer separated from Managed Farm Customer
Supplier Availability instead of platform-owned stock
Request availability before purchase when unconfirmed
Emergency wait-time decision and inter-governorate route
No competitor data leakage between suppliers
No fake availability / no Buy Now until supplier confirmation
Smart reorder reminders without automatic medical reordering
Master Product Catalog separated from Supplier Offers
Scientific master data controlled by veterinary/scientific role
FX rates with historical effective date
Worker/vet salary allocated to farm cost center
No hard delete for posted financial documents
Biological asset valuation / IAS 41 optional policy module
Doctor requirement -> finance review -> supplier verification
Three-Way Match: PO + GRN + Supplier Invoice
Farm Operations Chat per managed farm
Voice extraction confirmation before database write
GPS/time evidence for live field capture
Identity & Access Governance by account type
Vet performance scoring with non-outcome-only metrics
Legacy version modules hidden under compatibility area
Reduced white space and responsive density
Demo seed data isolated from production
